scope: Only this new directory may be written. Existing code, frozen evidence, data and live accounts remain read-only.

evidence_boundary.history_through_2026_09_24: Repeatedly searched development history; not clean OOS.
evidence_boundary.post_release_through_2026_11_16: Observed before mechanism design, therefore contaminated development diagnostic for this iteration; remains valid forward evidence of the original frozen R2 only.
evidence_boundary.current_day_2026_11_17: If data or returns viewed before final registration, label seen; otherwise use explicitly frozen cutoff. A timestamp alone cannot unsee data.
evidence_boundary.future: Only subsequent dates after final code/data/specification freeze add unseen evidence for this candidate family.
evidence_boundary.multiple_testing: Disclose prior 9558 V10 single-asset searches, V11, V12 1807, R2 864-grid, pool experiments, and all present proposals. Small present-family bootstrap p-values do not correct the entire adaptive history.

prior_evidence.anchor: old WLS25 V9.2, not present R2
prior_evidence.interpretation: Strong prior evidence of growth/risk tradeoff. Not a refutation under the R2 anchor and not a novel mechanism. Each retained 26 crash events.

Jointly removed crash eligibility (27 to 2 events) and negative-momentum fallback. Does not isolate fallback-only cash floor. Do not reuse its universal claims that every possible universe rule is refuted.

Prior allocation families already reduced risk; lowest-DD archived model had CAGR36.52%, DD13.10%, 2026 return21.05%. Crash-only sizing differs from sizing all normal risk exposure; include simple 50/75% exposure controls to identify mechanical de-risking.

No exact prior 512890 bear-exemption test located in inspected registrations/reports. Existing dividend universe expansion and leave-one-out are different hypotheses. 512890 first date 2019-01-18, 270-bar maturity 2020-03-03; do not invent pre-2020 eligibility.

candidate_scope_notes: 13 total records, 3 nonselectable controls, 10 proposed selectable records including single-mechanism ablations. Freeze all before first new return calculation; do not add combinations after seeing results.
If runtime budget requires smaller set, eliminate declared interactions before running, not after seeing which single mechanisms win.
WLS25/smooth4, MA180, panic1.4/prior-max20-60, crash channels/thresholds, 5-session lock and original buffers remain fixed.

semantics_that_must_be_frozen.crash_fraction: Recommended simple definition: allocate 50% or 75% on actual crash entry, residual in 511880; hold both actual units with drift throughout that crash-origin position, until next successful target change. No automatic full-risk top-up on lock expiry. This distinguishes persistent crash-entry sizing from a separate lock-only sizing model. Choose ONE before running.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.alternative_crash_fraction: If intended design instead restores 100% at first unlocked ordinary decision, state it explicitly, charge the resize, save the event, and do not add the persistent variant after results. Identical target with changed allocation is a real rebalance.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.cash_floor_scope: Apply exclusively inside ordinary fallback selection; do not filter ranked crash candidates or globally ban assets with negative momentum. A fallback risk holding with mom20<=0 requests cash; entry from actual cash through fallback requires mom20>0.02. Regular qualified entrants keep original gates. Specify whether to select first among eligible fallback assets or test only the top-ranked asset; recommended filter then rank, frozen as new behavior.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.cash_hysteresis: Use actual account state, not yesterday desired target. Missing quote or blocked trade does not change hysteresis state. Floor exit is not blocked by healthy min_hold or momentum switch buffer; existing crash lock priority remains unless explicitly a separate mechanism.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.dividend: Add 512890 to bear defensive competition without changing its stock ranking, 270-bar maturity or ordinary domestic 2% target buffer. Explicitly exempt it from the bear excluded_stock forced-exit condition; preserve failed_trend/overheat/panic exits. Do not merely put it in globals, which would accidentally change buffers/classification. It remains equity risk, not cash.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.signal_control: Use actual held risk asset plus actual allocation ledger. If a separate all-in shadow controller is chosen, disclose it as a new two-layer policy and validate missed/partial fills do not silently count as actual entries.
semantics_that_must_be_frozen.delay: For lag1 use signal information through t-1, execution at t close, actual entry age and lock index from t; never shift an already delayed tape again. Trigger-day returns belong to the asset held before execution.

qualification_proposal.main_history: 2014-01-02 through frozen 2026-09-24 only; latest post-release interval reported separately and never used as a winner tie-break.
qualification_proposal.primary_clock: same close, single-side 1bp, 244-session annualization, only first evaluation session free

strong_upgrade.label: historical growth/risk upgrade only, not proven future stronger

risk_efficiency_candidate.label: risk tradeoff, explicitly disclose CAGR concession; must not silently replace strong_upgrade

both_tiers_common.close11_and_lag1_11: Each full CAGR >=95% of same-scenario base; each absDD <= same-scenario base. Also report lag1_1 and fee21 stress; do not choose the most favorable clock.
both_tiers_common.era_growth: In close1, close11 and lag1_11, each era CAGR >= same-era base CAGR minus 0.05; at least two of three eras have equal-or-better Calmar in close11, to reject all improvement coming from one era.
both_tiers_common.era_risk: Each era absDD <= same-era base absDD +0.02 for close1, close11, lag1_11.
both_tiers_common.pre2026: Report full 2014-2025 separately; risk-efficiency CAGR retention and DD-improvement condition should also hold there to reject 2026-only rescue.
both_tiers_common.2026: Report cumulative through09-24 and 09-29 through current separately; no short-window annualization and no recent-winner selection.
both_tiers_common.empty_set: Report no qualified upgrade; never relax gates after seeing results or promote the best recent performer.

qualification_proposal.deterministic_ranking: Among eligible candidates within each tier maximize minimum relative Calmar gain across close11/lag1_11 x three eras; then median era relative CAGR, fewer new mechanisms, lower realized turnover, lexicographic semantic ID. Do not use recent 09/29 onward performance as tie-break.
qualification_proposal.notes: These numerical tolerances are pre-result research preferences, not statistical significance. Parent must accept/freeze one final specification before performance runs.

accounting_validation: The 100%-exposure control must reproduce original R2 daily target, panic/crash flags, fees, returns, locks and summary under all four main clock/fee scenarios, within stated floating-point tolerance. A same-engine baseline is mandatory if fee accounting differs.
Residual is tradable 511880 with its actual total-return path, not idle zero-interest cash. Store per-asset units; if 511880 quote is unavailable, never fabricate a purchase or its interest.

Revalue existing units before target calculation, let fractional weights drift between events, and charge each real buy/sell/rebalance. Do not simulate crash sizing by multiplying already-net base returns by a constant or freely reset 50/50 every day.

Specify fee model: exact self-financing buy/sell settlement or existing fee*L1 approximation. If using approximation, disclose it and run base in same model; all costs are portfolio-based realized traded notional, no double-count of full switches.

Corporate actions: raw price and split/cash entitlement require prior-holder units; do not apply raw cash dividend on top of a TR price return. TR-index-unit studies are theoretical reinvestment models, not broker share accounting.

If cash precision uncertainty scenarios are available, rebuild both signals and account returns for lower/upper dividend amounts; do not label them mathematical return bounds. Real payout delay and purchase costs remain unmodelled unless explicitly simulated.
Missing any held/requested positive security quote blocks the entire rebalance; retain units and lock/state, next date redecides. No sale-less purchase or temporary leverage.

Validate crash entry, lock expiry, target unchanged but allocation changes, delayed entry, missing risk/cash quote, split/dividend during partial exposure, first-day-free vs later-first-fill fees, and prior signal drop ownership.
All balances nonnegative, total marked NAV equals units*prices+idle cash, weights sum to one, no leverage, fee-inclusive conservation at each transaction.
Calendar and maturity remain actual-observation based; 512890 not tradable before listed and mature. Frozen open fields are close placeholders and cannot support next-open or intraday-stop claims.
robustness_and_reporting: Save all candidates and zero-effect/failed candidates, full daily matrix and final registration/source/input hashes before selection.
Compare crash-specific sizing with all-risk fixed50/fixed75 controls using CAGR, absDD, Calmar, risk exposure and cash share. A reduced-DD result alone proves no superior timing.

Report all crash events and clusters, including wins lost by sizing down. Original H/A/B/C had 27 events across 19 overlapping clusters; new clusters should be counted from own path, not called independent trades.
Run future-unseen period only after final freeze; all current comparisons are research evidence, not clean OOS for the new family.
If using bootstrap, use synchronized paired log-return time blocks (20 and60 sessions) across full family and family maximum statistic; never single-winner bootstrap as selection-adjusted proof.
Best-day/event exclusions are attribution only, not executable strategies. Do not reselect from sensitivity neighbors.
A passed historical gate justifies an isolated paper/forward candidate, not automatic replacement of live strategy. Preserve user instruction not to modify existing code.
